Oh, good!
You are all okay.
I dreamed some bad guys
had captured Akari.

Are you still half asleep?
We are anything but okay!
Those bad guys captured
all of us!
Do you remember what
happened after
we arrived?
We found the Digimon
who was calling for help.
Then the bad guys shocked
us and knocked us out!

Then what about Shoutmon
and the others?
They did not...

They must have taken them
while we were unconscious.
What now, Taiki?

What do you mean?
We rescue them, of course!

Always the same answer,
Taiki!
You are always saying
you have to help someone.
We are the ones who need
help right now!

That voice we heard
on the way here said
the same thing.
Hurry! I have to save
everyone!
It felt like my problem,
too. I could not ignore it.

Hi! Sorry to keep you
waiting!

Ah! You are the one
from before!

You are the Digimon
who was asking for help!

Shh! Keep it down!
We have to escape before
they spot us. Follow me!

Hold on a second.
What are you doing here?

You came to rescue us,
right? Of course I came
to rescue you!
My name is Spadamon.
Thank you for coming.

We should be thanking you!
I am Taiki Kudo.
This is Akari,
and that is Zenjiro.

Someone is coming!
Stay right where you are!

Hey, you lot!
I brought your friends!

Those idiots had to put
in this stupid door...
I fiddle with it forever
and still cannot open it.
And I am the only one
who can move them in
and out of here!

I doubt you can get out,
but listen up anyway!
Do not try anything funny,
or your friends will
pay for it!

Taiki! This is bad!
They took Sparrowmon
and the others somewhere!
I do not know what,
but those guys are up
to something!

Hey, you are the one
who called us here!
Did you not escape?

Yes, I escaped.
They helped me escape.
That time, and every
time before it, too.
Taiki...
Can I ask you a favor?

I want to rescue
everyone they captured.
My friends and yours.
All of them.
So please...
Will you help me?

Now we just have to get
past this door!

That is easy,
if you do not mind
being spotted.
Before the invaders
took over, this place
belonged to us!

blocks.notes: Actual new-game forest sequence, verified in emulator. Adapt the puni/buki wordplay as squishy/weapon; preserve Ballistamon's robotic delivery.
english:
You're the squishy one!
I said weapon Digimon!
Wea-pon Di-gi-mon!

Hey! I found Starmon
and the Pickmons!

What are you doing here?
We've been looking
everywhere for you!

Oh, Taiki.
Was it just these guys?
Where are the others?
Nene and Sparrowmon,
for instance?

Nene wandered off
and hasn't come back.
She didn't say where
she was going, and
I can't reach her.

Well, knowing them,
I'm sure they're fine.
They'll turn up again
before we know it.

You guys are awful!
Why did you all rush off
and leave me behind!?
What if I got lost
in this overgrown jungle!?

Sorry, Akari...
I was worried about
the Pickmons and got
a little carried away.

Ballistamon and I
were keeping an eye
on you, right?
We made sure you
didn't get lost!

BALLISTAMON HEARD
AKARI PANTING.
KNEW SHE WAS
FOLLOWING BEHIND!

If you knew I was
exhausted, you could've
helped me a little!

Easy there, brothers!
Forget that for a second
and take a look.
We found something cool!

It is impressive.
But what is it?

A weapon Digimon!
I've never seen
a real one before!
Like us, it can
turn into a weapon.
But this kind is
the oldest, strongest,
biggest, and rarest!

That's a Digimon...?
It isn't moving at all.

When a weapon Digimon
uses up all its power,
it turns back into
a weapon like this
and falls into
a very long sleep.

No idea, but probably
not for a long time.
None of these sleeping
weapon Digimon has
ever woken up before!

Wait a minute.
You just slipped in
something pretty serious.
This long sleep...
You don't mean the
rest-in-peace-forever
kind of sleep, do you?

I have to help...
I... have to help...!

What was that just now?
Help who...?

You were just standing
there, staring into space.
You wouldn't move or
answer when we spoke.
Are you feeling sick?

No, I'm fine.
I don't feel sick.
I just suddenly heard
someone's voice.

Like when you
first met Shoutmon?

Yeah, just like that.
But this voice sounded
so distant and faint...
It was gone before
I could say anything.

Then they're asking
you for help, Taiki!
All right! Let's split up
and find them!

Splitting up to look
is all well and good...
But haven't you forgotten
something important?

Hmm... The innocence
of our younger days?

No!
You were about to leave
Xros Heart's very own
life of the party behind!

Oh, you mean Cutemon?
He's with Dorulumon, right?

No, no, no!
Enough with the jokes!
You haven't forgotten
your pal Zenjiro,
have you?

Dorulumon, I feel bad
for Zenjiro, kyu...
They really did forget
him, just like I thought.

If we hadn't happened
to pick him up on the way,
he would've been left
all alone in the jungle.
They might never have
remembered him, either...

Shh!
Don't say something
that awful so loudly!
Zenjiro's sensitive
about going unnoticed.
You'll really hurt
his feelings, kyu!

Wait, wait, wait!
You, the pink one!
You're even louder,
and your comments
are really getting to me!
Stop before I curl up
on the ground and cry!

Zenjiro...
He disappeared, kyu!?
Was it because
I told the truth!?

Disappearing every time
that happens would be
quite an achievement.
Not a bad reaction
by his standards.

This is no time
to be so calm!
What just happened!?
Where did Zenjiro go!?
Taiki! Did he go into
your Xros Loader!?

No, he's human.
He can't go inside
a Xros Loader.
It looked like he was
teleported somewhere...

S-Somewhere...?
Any idea where
that might be...?

Ahh!
Now Dorulumon and
Cutemon are gone, too!?

BE CAREFUL, TAIKI.
SOMETHING IS WRONG.
THE ZONE WALL IS SHAKING.
SPACE IS DISTORTED.
A TREMENDOUS FORCE IS
PULLING US SOMEWHERE!

Pulling us where?
Who's doing this,
and why...?

Maybe it's whoever
Taiki heard earlier.

Oh, no...
Starmon and the others
are gone, too...

If it's that person,
are they trying to
bring us to them?
Why not just ask
for our help?
They didn't sound
like a bad person...

How can you be so relaxed
at a time like this!?
I don't know who it is
or what they want,
but anyone who does
something this crazy
has to be bad news!

Okay, I get it.
Then let's go!

They want us, right?
Then we'll go to them.
We'll soon find out
who they are and
what they want!

Yeah, I guess so.
It doesn't look like
we can get away, anyway.
Ballistamon and the others
are already there.
All right!
Let's go for it!

I have to help...
I... have to
save everyone...

Never mind that, Taiki.
Take a look.
We've definitely ended up
in another Zone.
But I've never traveled
in such a crazy way!

Where's Akari?
Zenjiro isn't here, either!

Yeah!
We've all been split up.
I just hope
this Zone is safe...

NO OTHER DIGIMON OR
HUMANS DETECTED NEARBY.
LET'S FIND AKARI
AND THE OTHERS. QUICKLY.

Yeah. Standing around
thinking won't help.
Let's go, Taiki!
